items.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: When I started doing really good studio work and I was doing dates with Bernie Glow and Mel Davis

ctx.x: But you want to make it work. You want it to sound good. And Mel Davis, who is a wonderful trumpet player, you talk about milestones in my career, Gerry Mulligan was one, doing that band, playing with Brookmeyer was a milestone. When I started doing really good studio work and I was doing dates with Bernie Glow and Mel Davis, who were the top two trumpet players in New York City for many years, I felt well I’ve arrived, you know I’m doing things with these guys and I’m able to kind of hold my own with them. Mel…
Wow. Very succinct he put it.
